about: Single source of truth for every challenge. Built September 2026 because a new challenge had to be registered by hand in twelve places across four runtimes, and every one of them failed silently on its own. See docs/challenge-architecture.md. Certificate wording lives on the track because it already varied by track on the Bible challenge, and because each track becomes its own challenge under the split. cardName is the short title for the hub, where the family heading already gives the context; name is the full title used everywhere else. theme is the one-line subtitle on the hub card; blurb is the longer description kept for anywhere that needs it.

reading.worker: workers/blog-cron/src/index.js imports this at build time

challenges.name: 31 Days of Living Hope
notes: Launches February 1, 2027. Signups before then are held to the 1st.

Its own challenge id rather than a track of august-james-2026, so finishing James and finishing 1 Peter count separately. The id already matches the naming in docs/challenge-architecture.md so it never needs renaming.
Heather wrote all 31 days herself. The focus field carries her 'Today's hope' line, which is this book's equivalent of the James prayer focus.
